content: Gamification pitfalls: 1) Streaks shift from accomplishment to loss-avoidance around day 30 - broken long streaks suppress engagement below baseline (Silverman & Barasch 2023). 2) Leaderboards need social context (scope to clans/cohorts, not global). 3) XP must map to high-value outcomes, not easy-to-count activities. 4) Mandatory gamification inverts motivation - make it opt-in. 5) Ship-and-forget kills gamification - need iteration cadence and tunable config (Duolingo ran 600+ experiments on streaks alone).
